decisions.reason: A dedicated offshore and renewables business unit was publicly launched as a flagship, ties directly to the firm's announced sustainable-shipping direction, and carries heavy invested resources, so management will persist with it.
Crew and corporate travel management builds on the firm's core crewing strength, and pandemic-era disruptions to crew travel can be framed as temporary rather than a reason to exit.
The online vessel portal was presented as a flagship of the firm's digital direction, so public commitment and sunk development costs make dropping it unlikely.
The mobile performance app is less visibly committed and could be folded into the portal, but it supports efficiency and cleaner-shipping goals, so the firm will most likely keep it.
